title: Token-aggregation + prefetch: regression watch and robustness evaluation
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Build a repeatable eval and monitoring harness that detects subtle quality regressions introduced by token-aggregation (microbatching/aggregation heuristics) and KV-prefetch policies. We want to understand the functional cost (response divergence, hallucination rate, structured-output integrity) per unit latency saved across representative production slices and ensure safe rollout rules for config changes. Background: Recent runtime work introduced an aggressive token-aggregation mode that reduces per-request overhead by merging short concurrent requests and a KV-prefetch heuristic that proactively warms KV caches for long-running chat sessions. Early perf gains are promising, but there are anecdotal degradations on structured tasks (code, JSON-extraction) and on certain prompt fingerprints. This ticket scopes an evaluation plan, orchestration for long-running watches, alert thresholds, and a canary gating policy for config rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) We can run a 10k-sample slice-based evaluation within CI that reports per-slice latency delta and quality regression scores for any candidate config change. 2) An alerting rule is defined that trips when weighted quality delta > 2% and latency improvement < 10% or when any structured-output integrity test fails. 3) Canary gating automation (deploy blocked/rollback) implemented in the rollout pipeline using the harness. 4) Dashboard widgets and a single-run report template are added to the perf dashboard.
evaluation_metrics:
- latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, throughput_rps, avg_tokens_per_request
- quality_emd (earth mover distance) on distribution of n-gram overlaps for freeform outputs
- structured_integrity_pass_rate (JSON/CSV extraction tests)
- hallucination_rate (precision/recall against reference KG)
- semantic_similarity_mean (embedding cosine vs golden)
- per-slice_weighted_regression_score (custom weighted delta)
- stability_score (variance of outputs across repeated seeds)
test_datasets:
- prod-sampled-10k (anonymized production traces covering web/chat/agent)
- code-generation-promptset-1k (open-source)
- structured-extraction-500 (forms + receipts)
- conversational-long-context-2k
- adversarial-prompt-fingerprints-200 (synthesized edge cases)
methodology: 1) Baseline run: current stable config (runtime-1.21) across full dataset. 2) Candidate runs: token-aggregation at three aggressiveness levels and KV-prefetch enabled/disabled + two TTL settings. 3) For each run capture deterministic outputs by pinning model version & seed, collect latency traces with synthetic burst injection to emulate microbursts. 4) Compute per-slice metrics and produce a regression matrix (quality delta vs latency improvement). 5) Statistical significance: bootstrap per-slice with 1000 resamples; highlight regressions with p < 0.05 and effect size > threshold. 6) Produce human-review digest for any failing slices with example prompts and diffs.
monitoring_playbook:
- Alert tier-1: structured_integrity_pass_rate drops by >1 percentage point for any slice -> page oncall infra.
- Alert tier-2: per-slice_weighted_regression_score > 2% for >30min -> create auto-ticket and pause rollout.
- Rollback rule: if any structured_integrity test fails OR global weighted quality delta >3% during canary -> immediate automatic rollback and notify SRE + PM.
- Follow-up: if alert fires, run postmortem within 72 hours and quarantine failing prompt fingerprints into a protected testset.
orchestration_and_harness:
- Integrate eval job into CI pipeline (github actions) that can be triggered by config PRs.
- Long-running watches: scheduled job every 6 hours that runs lightweight sampled checks and reports to dashboard.
- Canary gating: deployment job calls the harness with canary sample (1% traffic equivalent) and will auto-block if alerts fire.
- Repro artifacts: store outputs, diffs, and metric snapshots in a date-stamped folder on GCS and link in report.
checklist: seed evaluation harness and sample runner
implement deterministic output capture (model version + seed)
define per-slice weighting scheme with PM
hook canary gating into deploy pipeline
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: Small but high-impact regressions on rare prompt fingerprints may be masked by global averages. Mitigation: enforce per-slice thresholds and maintain adversarial fingerprint set.
- Risk: Increased monitoring load and storage. Mitigation: lightweight periodic checks + TTL on stored diffs.
- Risk: Flaky CI due to nondeterministic model IO. Mitigation: pin seeds and run small ensemble to estimate variance.
notes_or_decisions:
- Decided to prioritize structured-output integrity over marginal latency wins for enterprise tenants.
- We will treat KV-prefetch toggles as separate binary feature flags to allow independent rollback.
- Metric weighting will be: structured_integrity 40%, hallucination_rate 30%, semantic_similarity 20%, latency 10% (subject to PM signoff).
